review_improvement: Prevents generic sensor creation and keeps OOB consistent with the existing IB engineering decision.
independent_technical_reasoning: SDR records drive sensor interpretation and threshold behavior. A syntactically successful 0x24 write is unsafe without an authoritative record and targeted rollback, so the case remains blocked despite a known command family.
